details.resistances: slashing 10, piercing 10, bludgeoning 10, fire 10, cold 10, lightning 10, thunder 10, acid 10, necrotic 10
details.immunities: poison, condition:charmed, condition:frightened, psychic, non-magical, condition:paralysed, condition:petrified, condition:poisoned, condition:stunned, condition:prone
details.description:
Tiny undead

GM: What is left of a lich that kept its phylactery too long: a skull, a handful of dust and a hunger for souls. It is the deadliest trap in the dungeon, and it looks like treasure.

Solo: acts twice a round, on its initiative and again 10 lower (the system adds its second turn; the second repeats its attacks, never a spell or limited ability). Anything that stops it acting, attacking, moving or casting ends after two of its turns (one, the second time in a fight), then nothing of the kind affects it until the end of the following round; the first time it drops to half HP every condition and hostile effect ends and its breath weapons and other limited-use abilities recover (not its spells); area, aura and ongoing damage and regeneration come once a round, at the start of its first turn (all automatic). An effect that would kill it outright, banish or imprison it, or Exhaustion from a spell, costs it its next two turns instead (yours to run); only one of Harm and Mass Harm can affect it in a fight. Damage to 0 HP still kills it.

system.description:
Immune to poison, sleep, charm, fear and psychic damage, and to damage from non-magical weapons.

  • Resistance 10 to all other damage except force and radiant.
  • Cannot be @Condition[paralysed]{Paralysed}, @Condition[petrified]{Petrified}, @Condition[poisoned]{Poisoned}, @Condition[stunned]{Stunned} or knocked prone.
On a successful save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, it takes none.

Once per day, as an action, every creature within 30ft that can hear it makes a @Check[fort|dc:23]{Fortitude save DC 23} or takes @Damage[10d10 necrotic]{10d10 necrotic damage}, half on a success; a creature reduced to 0 HP by it falls @Condition[unconscious]{Unconscious} and stable. A creature that saves is @Condition[frightened]{Frightened} until the end of its next turn.

As an action, up to three creatures within 10ft make a @Check[fort|dc:19]{Fortitude save DC 19} or take @Damage[6d6 necrotic]{6d6 necrotic damage}, and the demilich regains the total. This is also its second action each round.

Once per day, as an action, it targets one creature within 30ft: @Check[will|dc:23]{Will save DC 23} or its soul is pulled into one of the gems in the demilich's skull, and its body crumbles. A soul trapped for 24 hours is devoured; breaking the gem before then frees it, and @UUID[Compendium.arneyan.spells.Item.RjGWGxIhUqHUiLMv]{wish} or @UUID[Compendium.arneyan.spells.Item.8XhTI839UkXWg4Sr]{true resurrection} can return it.
The skull rests, apparently harmless, until a creature disturbs its treasure or lair; then it rises.

items.name: Villain Action 1 (Opener): Rise from the Hoard

system.description:
Dust and bone swirl 20ft around it as it rises 30ft. Each enemy in the swirl makes a @Check[will|dc:23]{Will save DC 23} or is @Condition[frightened]{Frightened} until the end of its next turn.

Opener damage (Villain actions, Monsters & Treasure): on top of its control, @Damage[13]{13 damage} to one creature it affects, or @Damage[6]{6} to each creature in an area, of a type that suits it, in place of any smaller damage listed.

Each creature within 20ft makes a @Check[fort|dc:23]{Fortitude save DC 23}, taking @Damage[4d8 necrotic]{4d8 necrotic damage} and being unable to regain HP until the end of its next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

One creature within 30ft makes a @Check[fort|dc:23]{Fortitude save DC 23}. On a failure it takes @Damage[10d8 necrotic]{10d8 necrotic damage}, and the demilich regains half of it; on a success, half damage.
